The '''Rigelian Iris''' was a [[Flower/Legends|flower]] from [[Rigel VII|Rigel 7]], noted for the way it seemed to open at the touch of a hand. When the [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Whie Malreaux/Legends|Whie Malreaux]] was five years old, he hid behind a Rigelian [[Iris (flower)|Iris]]. After that, he opened the flower by using [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].<ref name="Yoda">''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]'' {{Ab|Yoda: Dark Rendezvous (unabridged audiobook)}}</ref>
